spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:6:3: command demo: flag "order": default must be a single scalar value, not a list — a default is carried as one string and coerced through the input's type, so a repeatable input has no way to declare several. Seed the multi-value default in the handler, or have the user repeat the flag
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:6:3: command demo: flag "labels": default must be a single scalar value, not a map — a default is carried as one string and coerced through the input's type, so a repeatable input has no way to declare several. Seed the multi-value default in the handler, or have the user repeat the flag
